subject: Tenant students can reach Hexworth-branded marketing pages (about, product-info, admissions deck)
description:
Chris found while auditing version/codename leaks. about.html and product-info.html are linked from the dashboard and landing-page menus, and both link on to components/slides/admissions-2026.html. All three are Hexworth marketing: brand name in body prose, title, meta description, og:title, og:site_name, twitter:title and JSON-LD. TenantShell.js:653-660 only rewrites document.title (a regex replace on 'Hexworth Prime'); it never touches body text or meta tags, so shell injection does not rescue these. Removing the frozen version strings from about.html and product-info.html (done 2026-09-02) fixed the codename leak and two-versions-stale claims, but NOT the underlying question: should a white-label student be able to reach Hexworth's own about/pricing/admissions material at all? That is a product decision, not a bug fix, and it is the same class as BUG-251. Options: tenant-gate those routes, give TenantShell a body-text/meta pass, or accept it. Needs an operator answer.
[2026-09-06 03:03] MEASURED 2026-09-05, and it narrows the decision a lot. LEAK SURFACE: about.html 25 brand mentions + 4 meta/JSON-LD, product-info.html 25 + 4, components/slides/admissions-2026.html 10 + 0. TenantShell only rewrites document.title (a regex on the title string at :656-660) and never body text or meta, so shell injection genuinely does not rescue these. REACHABILITY IS ONE LINK, NOT A CLASS: grep finds 8 inbound referrers but 7 are under _app/_archive/, which firebase.json never serves (the ignore list covers _*), so the ONLY live path is a single <a href="/about.html"> at dashboard.html:3981 in the header menu. That means the decision is not 'gate these routes' but 'should this one dashboard link render for a tenant student', which is much smaller. FEASIBILITY: TenantShell.overrideLinks already iterates document.querySelectorAll('a[href]') for every link on the page, so hiding or rewriting a marketing link needs no new traversal, just a rule inside the loop that already exists. Still a product decision (hide the link for tenants / rewrite it to the tenant's own about page / give TenantShell a body+meta pass / accept it), so it goes to the panel, but whoever decides now has the actual numbers instead of a category.
